name: Ced-NeRF
definition: A compact and efficient method for dynamic neural radiance fields that uses a grid-based hybrid representation and a canonical space to model motion, aiming to prevent overfitting artifacts (floaters, noisy geometry) common in hybrid representations of dynamic scenes.
summary: Ced-NeRF is a compact dynamic neural radiance field method using a high-resolution grid and canonical space to prevent overfitting artifacts while ensuring rapid convergence and efficient rendering.
